name: knowledge_p2
description: Phase 2 knowledge evaluation. 'dev' may be used to choose thresholds and settings; 'heldout' must not be. 'sources' lists every article that answers the question (any one counts); null means the knowledge base does not contain the answer (in-domain gap) or the question is not about banking (unrelated). Written from the articles' subjects, not from retrieval output.
